doc.title: Dick Hyman interviewed by Monk Rowe, Scottsdale, Arizona, March 4, 1995 [interview 1 of 2]

title: Lessons with Teddy Wilson won in a radio contest
summary: Hyman won twelve lessons with Teddy Wilson and stayed friends with him.

story.theme_name: Growing up and learning music: family, first instruments, teachers
story.community_name: Learning your horn: teachers, lessons and fees

blocks.x: I understand you studied some with Teddy Wilson early on.

Yeah I did. I won a contest, a local radio station had a contest and the prize was twelve lessons with Teddy Wilson. So I did do that, and it was wonderful. I continued to be friends with him until he passed away a few years ago.
